|japanese=Hakutai Historical Museum |image=Eterna Museum.png |imagesize=250px |region=Sinnoh |epicode=DP036 |episode=A Secret Sphere of Influence! }} The '''Eterna Historical Museum''' (Japanese: '''ハクタイ{{tt|歴史博物館|れきしはくぶつかん}}''' ''Hakutai Historical Museum'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive building located in [[Eterna City]] in [[Sinnoh]]. It appeared in ''[[DP036|A Secret Sphere of Influence]]'', in which it was visited by {{Ash}}, {{an|Dawn}}, {{an|Brock}}, [[Nando]], and [[Gardenia]], the local [[Gym Leader]]. [[File:Eterna Space-Time Tower.png|thumb|left|220px|Diorama of the Space-Time Towers]] [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}} were hired by [[Saturn]], one of [[Team Galactic]]'s {{tc|Commander}}s, to steal the [[Adamant Orb]]. Although they managed to get a hold of the orb, they failed to escape the museum with it after the building was surrounded by policemen working under the orders of [[Officer Jenny]]. In ''[[DP096|Losing Its Lustrous!]]'', the Adamant Orb was being transported on a police plane to the [[Celestic Town Historical Research Center]], where it would be studied along with the [[Lustrous Orb]]. However, it was stolen by Team Galactic, which intercepted the aircraft transporting the Adamant Orb. Among the many artifacts inside the museum are a scale model of the [[Space-Time Towers]] and statues of {{p|Uxie}}, {{p|Mesprit}}, and {{p|Azelf}}.
